52:t_000:0.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「All units, you heard the order! The operation has failed! Jettison your $$クローザーパス$$ and withdraw!」

52:t_000:1.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Hurry back! You'll be left behind!」

52:t_001:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Damn you, $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$...! How dare you!」

52:t_001:3.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「...All right. Just hold out for 200 seconds. Don't take unnecessary risks.」

52:t_001:4.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「When this operation is over, you should be permitted to travel to and stay on 《$$アヴァロン$$》.」

52:t_002:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#robot$$ is withdrawing.」

52:t_004:1.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Fall back, $$レド$$! Leave this one to me!」

52:t_004:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$...! That's against military regulations!」

52:t_004:3.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「You're still young. You can kill more enemies than I can. That is a soldier's judgment.」

52:t_004:5.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Glory to the $$人類銀河同盟$$. Take care.」

52:t_004:7.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. A force distinct from the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ is approaching this area.」

52:t_005:1.en:
$$レド$$
「They intend to attack both us and the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ here?!」

52:t_005:2.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「All units, be careful! The enemy will use space-time weapons!」

52:t_006:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. Abnormal distortion confirmed in the surrounding dimensional boundaries. At this rate...」

57:t_1:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「He's been sitting there without a word the whole time?」

57:t_1:6.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Yeah. And that tin bastard's behind him, so we can't touch him.」

57:t_1:7.en:
$$ルカ$$
「I've checked for life signs. That black unit appears able to operate without a pilot.」

57:t_1:8.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「You mean it can move with nobody inside?」

57:t_1:9.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Yes. I believe it carries out his orders.」

57:t_1:10.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「$$クルツ$$! $$ミシェル$$! Shoot through him with your rifles, like you did this afternoon!」

57:t_1:11.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Well, it's not like we couldn't, but...」

57:t_1:12.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm not doing something that'll keep me up at night.」

57:t_1:13.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What the hell?! Without him around, that tin bastard would be ours!」

57:t_1:14.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Stop it, $$ピニオン$$. That would make us no different from pirates.」

57:t_1:15.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「$$ベローズ$$! You're taking his side too?!」

57:t_1:16.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「He took $$エイミー$$ hostage and tried to escape!」

57:t_1:17.en:
$$エイミー$$
「But I don't think he's a bad person.」

57:t_1:20.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You think so too, $$ティファ$$?」

57:t_1:22.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Are you serious, $$エイミー$$, $$ティファ$$?!」

57:t_1:23.en:
$$エイミー$$
「But... He fought to help the fleet, didn't he?」

57:t_1:24.en:
$$エイミー$$
「And even when he took me hostage, he wasn't that scary.」

57:t_1:25.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You're all out of your minds...!」

57:t_1:26.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...I hear $$リジット$$'s going to talk to him tomorrow. Let's leave someone on watch and get some sleep tonight.」

57:t_1:27.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah, let's. I'm tired after today's fighting.」

57:t_1:33.en:
$$レド$$
[No... I wonder... what's going to happen to us...]

57:t_1:34.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Insufficient data to make a judgment.]

57:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you for your hard work, $$ガロード$$.」

57:t_10:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「So you're $$ＡＧ$$. $$ワッ太$$ and the others told me about you.」

57:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It must have been hard babysitting someone you couldn't communicate with today.」

57:t_10:8.en:
$$ガロード$$
「But $$ティファ$$ said he wasn't a bad guy.」

57:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, communicating with the quiet type like that must be mentally exhausting in all sorts of ways.」

57:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Unless, of course, it's a beautiful girl you fell in love with at first sight.」

57:t_10:11.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Cut it out. $$ティファ$$ isn't the quiet type like that.」

57:t_10:12.en:
$$ガロード$$
「She's reserved... No, demure... That's not it. Elegant... Um...」

57:t_10:13.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Anyway, $$ティファ$$'s the best!」

57:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sorry, $$ガロード$$... I really don't think I stand any chance of beating you.」

57:t_10:15.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I don't quite get it, but okay.」

57:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, $c has a specialist at babysitting the quiet type. Let's leave it to that person from now on.」
